primary_workload: paged buffered: 4 workers, 128 rows x 4 KiB, page size 32, four populated plus terminal empty page
metric: allocated bytes per partition (memory candidate), CPU/op regression <=2%; all controls per roadmap
mechanism: replace escaping full InternalExecutionRequest page copy with immutable per-page tablet feedback/version value captured by asynchronous attempt closures
memory_budget: no additional retained storage; smaller capture per page; existing streaming request fields preserved
acceptance: at least 10% lower allocated bytes/op; focused microbenchmark is screening only; parent requires canonical A-B-B-A, confirmation, real Scylla and controls
audit: InternalAdmitExecution constructs a private request copy and finalizes options/routing/logical execution before returning it; buffered page execution subsequently reads that request
pageRoutingCapture is a local value shared read-only by one executePage call; separate pages never write its feedback/version fields
executeTypedAttempt reads the captured feedback stamp and version even after later page starts; retries/repair reuse the same stamp
Async workers, input retain/release, writer leases, delayed retries, observer invocation, winner cancellation and loser response release remain unchanged
InternalExecutionRequest tabletFeedback and tabletVersionBlock are still used by the separately owned streaming request and are intentionally retained
coverage: new serial and prefetched continuation test with accepted blocked loser writer, retained page lease, and Close/Wait timing
existing stamp/placement fence tests cover stale metadata, overlapping observations, schema identity changes and enqueue ownership
